### [Supporting ambitious external research through the Anthropic Economic Futures Research Fund](https://www.anthropic.com/news/economic-futures-research-fund-agenda)

**Anthropic** · 2026-07-24

Anthropic has committed $200 million to the Economic Futures Research Fund to support external research on interventions preparing society for AI's economic impacts, prioritizing large-scale projects and pilots.

- Anthropic is committing $200 million to the Economic Futures Research Fund to support external research.
- The fund will prioritize five research areas focused on interventions to make economies flexible and resilient, ensure shared AI benefits, and minimize disruption.
- Projects will primarily be funded in the $5-30 million range, with a minimum of $1 million, and may exceed $30 million for high-potential-impact projects.
- The fund seeks ambitious proposals, including large-scale Randomized Controlled Trials (RCTs), creative pilots, and program evaluations, with a global scope.
- Research organizations are expected to share learnings publicly at key milestones to enable timely action.

**Why it matters:** This initiative aims to build an evidence base for effective interventions in an AI-transformed economy, guiding workers, firms, and governments in adaptation.
